name: Nyársapát (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a narrow green band at the top and bottom, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyársapát (a white and red shield with a tree, a bunch of grapes and a castle) below the name NYÁRSAPÁT in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
